response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in production routing or navigation systems, and his work with DLang and Node.js doesn't clearly align with the core requirements of high-performance routing tile pipelines, though his open-source geospatial work and systems thinking are promising.
strengths: Built and maintained open-source geospatial platform (GISCollective) used in production by NGOs
Demonstrated systems-level thinking through low-latency DLang services and distributed infrastructure
Strong track record of learning new technologies and contributing across full stack and domains
concerns: No demonstrated commercial experience with C++ or Rust in routing, navigation, or geospatial data pipelines
Primary recent work is in TypeScript/Node.js, not the C++-centric stack required for this role
Lacks explicit experience with routing tile optimization, real-time traffic integration, or map data consistency at scale
